summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a call notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting on May 28, 2026. The agenda includes bylaw amendments reflecting a new shareholders' agreement disclosed in Material Facts on April 20 and 23, 2026, extending minimum convening periods, updating governance committees, and aligning board and executive terms. The meeting also covers election of board members and fiscal council replacements. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation deal terms are stated. The filing is a routine governance meeting notice, not a special situation.
